gloss: chugging; downing a drink in one go

definitions.gloss: chugging; downing a drink in one go; draining a glass
definitions.explanation: The act of drinking an entire beverage without stopping, typically alcoholic drinks. Often done under social pressure at parties and gatherings.

examples.japanese: {一気飲|いっきの}みは{危険|きけん}だ。
{大学|だいがく}の{飲|の}み{会|かい}で{一気飲|いっきの}みを{強要|きょうよう}された。
examples.english: I was pressured to chug at a college drinking party.

examples.japanese: {急性|きゅうせい}アルコール{中毒|ちゅうどく}の{事故|じこ}が{続|つづ}いたため、{多|おお}くの{大学|だいがく}が{一気飲|いっきの}みを{禁止|きんし}している。
examples.english: Because incidents of acute alcohol poisoning have continued, many universities have banned chugging.

notes:
CULTURE:
A practice associated with Japanese drinking culture, particularly at university welcome parties ({新歓|しんかん}コンパ). It has been a serious social issue due to deaths from acute alcohol poisoning. Most universities and companies now prohibit it. The chant "{一気|いっき}！{一気|いっき}！" (Chug! Chug!) is used to pressure someone into drinking.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一気飲|いっきの}みをする (to chug)
- {一気飲|いっきの}みを{強要|きょうよう}する (to pressure someone to chug)
- {一気飲|いっきの}み{禁止|きんし} (ban on chugging)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {一気|いっき}に{飲|の}む: to drink in one go — verb phrase rather than noun
